_about: Every interactive thing in the game. kind = one of the six kinds from The living map. New things are a new entry here, no code. Sizes in metres, mass in kg, speeds in m/s. verb = what the E hint says. sound = a name in data/sounds.json. splat = the colour a thing leaves on the floor when it breaks.

kinds.prop: Physics prop: pushed, stacked, toppled, rolled.
kinds.machine: Machine or switch: changes the room for everyone.
kinds.ride: Ride: fast, wobbly, hard to steer.
kinds.hide: Hiding spot: breaks line of sight, lets suspicion drain.
kinds.disguise: Disguise prop: held in your hands to blend in.
kinds.food: Food or throwable: splats, stains, slips.

tin.name: Tin of beans
tin.funny: Topple a tin pyramid onto a queue.
tin.useful: A falling tin is a noise that pulls a guard away from the door.

tin_pyramid.name: Tin pyramid
tin_pyramid.funny: Bowl a melon into it and watch forty tins go everywhere.
tin_pyramid.useful: The crash is the loudest noise in the shop: everyone runs to look.

can.name: Can of fizzy pop
can.funny: Cans roll out of the vending machine and under everyone's feet.
can.useful: Roll a can down an aisle to make a noise far away.

box.name: Cardboard box
box.funny: Stack boxes into a wobbly ramp and skid off it.
box.useful: Block a door or build a ramp to a high shelf.
box.reaction: The shelf stacker sighs and restacks them.

wet_floor_sign.name: Wet floor sign
wet_floor_sign.funny: Kick it over and it says CAUTION on its back, like a turtle.
wet_floor_sign.useful: Grown-ups walk the long way round a wet floor sign: put one in a doorway.
wet_floor_sign.reaction: "Careful, it's... oh. It's not even wet."

light_switch.name: Light switch
light_switch.useful: Darkness to sneak past the tills.

vending_machine.name: Vending machine
vending_machine.funny: Kick it and it coughs cans at everyone like a cannon.
vending_machine.useful: A pile of rolling cans in an aisle trips up anyone chasing you.

tannoy.name: Tannoy microphone

announcements.text: Would the owner of a red car please come to the car park. It's on fire. A bit.
Clean-up on aisle 1, someone has been sick in the cereal.
Security to the staff room please, security to the staff room.

tannoy.funny: Announce "Free cake at the bakery!" and watch the stampede.
tannoy.useful: Send the whole crowd, guard included, to the other end of the shop.
tannoy.reaction: "Who was that? That's not Brenda's voice."

freezer_door.name: Freezer door
freezer_door.funny: Open all the freezer doors: the aisle fills with fog and turns into an ice rink.
freezer_door.useful: Fog hides you; the ice makes anyone chasing you skid past.

trolley.name: Shopping trolley
trolley.funny: Trolley race straight through the checkout queue.
trolley.useful: Quick getaway with heavy loot; let go and it keeps rolling into whatever is ahead.

conveyor.name: Till conveyor belt
conveyor.verb: lie on the belt like shopping
conveyor.funny: Ride the belt past the cashier and get scanned: BEEP. "Er... one coat?"
conveyor.useful: The quickest way through the tills, and nobody looks twice at shopping.

big_box.name: Big delivery box
big_box.funny: A box that tiptoes when nobody is looking.
big_box.useful: Lose a chase and let the "?" meters drain.
big_box.reaction: The guard pokes it, shrugs and walks on.

mannequin.name: Mannequin
mannequin.verb: hold Q to strike a pose
mannequin.funny: Stand in the mannequin row and freeze in a pose while the guard inspects you.
mannequin.useful: Hidden in plain sight, as long as you don't move.
mannequin.reaction: "Was that one there before? ...Was it holding a lolly?"

coat_rack.name: Coat rack
coat_rack.funny: A trench coat on a coat rack. Perfect camouflage.
coat_rack.useful: Stand still here and nobody sees you.
coat_rack.reaction: "Funny, I don't remember hanging up a coat with legs."

inflatable.name: Inflatable banana display
inflatable.funny: Bump it and the giant banana wobbles and squeaks for ages.
inflatable.useful: Stand still behind it near the entrance and nobody sees you.

mop.name: Mop
mop.funny: Wave a mop at the guard and stroll past.

clipboard.name: Clipboard
clipboard.funny: Walk around with a clipboard nodding at things: grown-ups straighten up when you pass.
clipboard.useful: Nobody questions someone with a clipboard.

cream_cake.name: Cream cake
cream_cake.useful: The splat leaves a slippery patch behind you.

ketchup.name: Ketchup bottle
ketchup.funny: Squirt a ketchup trail and watch the guard moonwalk on it.
ketchup.useful: Hold it and click: a slippery ketchup trail behind you.

melon.name: Melon
melon.funny: Bowl a melon into a tin pyramid.
melon.useful: Rolls round corners: a noise you can send somewhere else.
